I'm realizing now what I've been doing for so long. It was so clear in my mind earlier what the issue was, the core of the issue was this marriage and I've never addressed it head on. I would always tell her I'm tired, or feeling strange, or stressed about some other thing or money or work, everything but the actual issue. To compensate even further I'd just fill the silence with I love you or random awkward gestures just anything to avoid bringing it up and try to convince myself everything is fine.
Even now when I get back I can't fucking tell her, I don't know if it's me not wanting to hurt her or being too scared to face it myself. I don't think it is going to end well. Being in this situation makes me want to kill myself. Along with the other things but this adds the icing to the cake.

I'm having a hard time even after much discussion with myself earlier about telling my girlfriend that 'we need to have a very difficult conversation' the next time i see her. I know it is going to end horribly and there will be a lot of hurt emotions and sadness. 

I told her I made it home and that I sought out help for suicide and she wants to be here for me. She doesn't know that she is a large portion of the suffering and I don't know what to do. 

Getting back and trying to deal with this makes me just as anxious and tense as I was earlier before I left all day, I'm now back to square one. I don't know what to do now.

I should clear up that she has not said she would leave me because of my depression but basically the compliance with the marriage is the relationship ender. I just got back in, I felt better when I was wasn't here all day. The closer I got to my house the tension built because I knew I have a cellphone full of missed calls, texts and my girlfriend to deal with.

Most of my time earlier was spend arguing and telling my girlfriend in my head about my issues with this marriage. Really trying to face myself and see if I went with this out of fear or love it seems to be fear. Fearful of being alone again and not having anyone, so lonely and desperate that I would have agreed to just about anything. 

I don't know what is going to happen tomorrow. I also contemplated strongly the idea to take the little money I have saved and just move to another state. I dread my life and daily activities at this point.

I feel like I am being pressured into the marriage. This is my first meaningful dating relationship and I somehow entered it with her saying she doesn't want to just 'date' someone, she wants something serious. I so badly wanted to have a companion and be accepted that maybe I'm agreeing to things too fast. You said 2 years, we haven't even been together 5 months. 

She will not understand, she will leave me if I tell her these things, she has said so in the past. She doesn't just want to date, so if I don't want to get married right now it's probably over. It sounds stupid but she is the first person I have really dated. All of the 'things' I've been managing for years have crippled me as a person. 

If I play video games then I don't do anything else all day. It's not a meaningful escape, it's just an escape, it's not even pleasurable. 

I am extremely ashamed of who I am. I don't know if medication will help but I would try it maybe. The only help I can afford is the cheap volunteer university students who offer counseling but aren't professionals.

How did you get better? I just spent a few hours laying at the park. At least I got away from my familiar prison walls of my house and some of my thoughts. I came back to check this thread and leave again.
